newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-SUNDAY'S RESULTS FROM THE U.S. OPEN.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-SUNDAY'S RESULTS FROM THE U.S. OPEN.

text.p: Results from the U.S. Open Tennis Championships at the National Tennis Centre on Sunday ( prefix number denotes seeding):
Women's singles, fourth round 4-Conchita Martinez (Spain) beat Asa Carlsson (Sweden) 6-2 6-1
2-Monica Seles (U.S.) beat Sandrine Testud (France) 7-5 6-0 Amanda Coetzer (South Africa) beat Lisa Raymond (U.S.) 6-4
Men's singles, third round Stefan Edberg (Sweden) beat Paul Haarhuis (Netherlands) 6-4 7-6 (7-4) 6-1
4-Goran Ivanisevic (Croatia) beat Hendrik Dreekmann (Germany) 6-3 6-2 7-6 (13-11) Guy Forget (France) beat Sjeng Schalken (Netherlands) 6-2 7-5 4 -6 4-6 6-0

Alex Corretja (Spain) beat Jonas Bjorkman (Sweden) 6-2 4-6 4-6 6-4 6-3 Mark Philippoussis (Australia) beat 16- Cedric Pioline (France) 6-3 6-2 6-4 1-Pete Sampras (U.S.) beat Alexander Volkov (Russia) 6-3 6-4 6- 2
Andrei Medvedev (Ukraine) beat Petr Korda (Czech Republic)
